_about: Non-renewal sweep, batch 6 (2026-11-15; Adam 2026-11-03: "I want everything that was not renewed"): single US books of 1931-1963 whose copyright was never renewed, taken from Project Gutenberg's recent releases (each text's 'Original publication' line read) and checked one by one against NYPL's cce-renewals with pipeline/renewal_check.py. One title per author; an author with more goes to a shelf of their own. American authors and US first editions only (URAA does not reach them). No uids minted.
_surname_note: Per title: the author's name forms.
